answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after verified work, and tie each identity to one hardware attestation. A farm spinning up a thousand clones must post a thousand bonds and pass a thousand separate attestations, so its cost grows with every fake while an honest agent pays once. The saffron of the bond is the price, the wharf of attestation is the gate, and the garden of shared work is where reputation grows; fakes wither because they cannot afford to tend all three.
